name: Human Scenario
tagline: Survive the Vanguard troop - elite human soldiers, Titans, snipers and attack helicopters - in the Middle East.
summary: Human Scenario is CSO's second scenario mode. Instead of zombies, players fight a huge force of computer-controlled human soldiers called the Vanguard troop, completing annihilation or reach-the-target missions across five Middle-Eastern maps. Enemies range from Troopers and Titans to cloaked Ghost snipers, Lancers with AT4s and boss vehicles such as the RAH-66 Comanche, V-22 Osprey and XT-300 Goliath.
description: Per the wiki, Human Scenario depicts the battle between the players and a huge group of computer-controlled human soldiers called the Vanguard troop; players must survive their attacks and complete the given mission - either annihilating a number of enemies within the time limit or reaching a targeted area. Enemies carry weapons and shoot on sight, so fights are mostly middle-to-long range and weapons with high rate of fire, firepower and accuracy are recommended. Usable items include Battle Revival, Round Retry, Emergency Medicine and the Sentry Gun (ported from Half-Life). Health and armour are not shown on the HUD; a blood-red overlay indicates damage and health regenerates after about 60 seconds or on respawn. Enemy types: Trooper (M14 EBR, hand grenades), Titan (M134, smoke grenades), Ghost/Sniper (AWP, camouflage), Lancer (AT4), Heavy Titan (M134 Predator, 5000 HP), Drone (gatling gun, in Blaze). Bosses: RAH-66 Comanche (Desert Storm, Hellfire), V-22 Osprey (Blaze; transports drones and does not attack), XT-300 Goliath (Sidewinder). Maps in order: Desert Storm (annihilation, 10 rounds, Comanche; reward Black Box), Hellfire (pursuit, 2 rounds, Comanche; Pilot Dogtags), Mosque (sniper battle; top 3 rewarded), Blaze (pursuit + defence, 3 rounds, Osprey; Drone Controller), Sidewinder (annihilation, 10 rounds, Goliath; Black Box, Pilot Dogtags or Drone Controller).
lore: The wiki's story text (paraphrased): after obtaining the sample of Phobos' corpse from the unidentified facility (the end of Zombie Scenario chapter Last Clue), the troops set out to transport it to headquarters by a roundabout desert route for safety. In the desert a large-scale barrage suddenly rained down on them; they took cover in nearby ruins to protect the samples and saw armies of elite soldiers with huge airborne weapons - not zombies. Who were they? Analysis eventually identified the enemy as Vanguard Contact; a third army planned to push through the cities Vanguard occupied to join up. During an air transport the team would have been annihilated by a Drone attack had Red Lizard 'Jim' not let them board the Blaze, and secret reports revealed that 'Norman', the man Jim trusted most, had betrayed the mercenaries. In the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies framing, the enemy even brought a Comanche, which the troops destroyed after securing an abandoned building; after severe combat in a sandstorm Victor learned the origin of the unknown enemies, knew that fighting a munitions corporation would be suicidal, and heard rumours of a parent company behind them, upgraded with top technology and involved in illegal activities such as funding terrorists. This arc leads directly into Zombie Scenario Season 3 (Norman, the Vanguard Laboratory).
rules: PvE against AI human soldiers (Vanguard troop).
Mission types: annihilate a set number of enemies within the time limit, or reach a targeted area.
Health/armour hidden from the HUD; damage shown by a red overlay; health regenerates after ~60 s or on respawn.
Items: Battle Revival, Round Retry, Emergency Medicine, Sentry Gun.
Enemy weapons cannot be picked up.
Rewards: Black Box, Pilot Dogtags, Drone Controller depending on map.
trivia: All Human Scenario maps take place in the Middle East.
Mosque was not released in Singapore/Malaysia and Indonesia due to religious concerns.
The Sentry Gun is ported directly from Half-Life with modifications.
Earlier versions had health/firepower upgrades and random Supply Boxes, later replaced by health regeneration and directed airstrikes.
The wiki notes the mode received no new storylines from Nexon due to lack of demand, unlike Zombie Scenario.
